yorp: Enable SINK_CTRL on PPC before hibernating It was observed on yorp that connecting AC when EC is in hibernation does not always reliably wake the EC up. The reason for this seems to be that USB_C0_CHARGE_ON from ANX7447 is not asserting SINK_CTRL and PPC does not pass through ACIN and thus ACOK_OD remains low. This change ensures that SINK_CTRL is enabled on all the ports before EC goes into hibernate state. BUG=b:79173959 BRANCH=None TEST=Verified that EC wakes up from hibernate reliably with AC insert. Change-Id: I14ff2c89511993fec53462ac606b92e5d9438739 Signed-off-by: Furquan Shaikh <furquan@google.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1043076 Commit-Ready: Furquan Shaikh <furquan@chromium.org> Tested-by: Furquan Shaikh <furquan@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Jett Rink <jettrink@chromium.org>

yorp: Configure GPIO_HIB_WAKE_HIGH for AC_PRESENT AC_PRESENT is active high and hence GPIO_HIB_WAKE_HIGH needs to be set in order to wake the EC up from hibernate. container_utils: disambiguate file descriptor ownership The DeviceJailServer constructor takes ownership of the passed file descriptor, but the FD is passed bare, meaning it might be interpreted as a "weak" reference to the FD that it doesn't clean up.
